title: Imidlalo nokuzivocavoca
description: Ten short stories about sport and exercise: a winter marathon, a round of golf with an Englishman, a sea race in October, a school dance contest, a boxer's diet, a sprinter learning French for Paris, a concrete wall that collapses by a football pitch, a stolen running trophy, a stick game at a wedding, and a school sports day.

lessons.title: Ukugijima ebusika
lessons.summary: Mlindeli of Pietermaritzburg trains all winter for a long July race to Durban: he shivers in the frost, warms up first, sweats on the road, hurts a toe until he buys bigger shoes, runs on through cloudy evenings and finishes the race.
lessons.text:
UMlindeli uneminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Uhlala eMgungundlovu, futhi uthanda ukugijima kakhulu. NgoNtulikazi uzogijima umjaho omude osuka eMgungundlovu uye eThekwini. Lo mjaho mude kakhulu, ngakho uMlindeli uyazilungiselela nsuku zonke.

UNtulikazi uyinyanga ebanda kakhulu eKwaZulu-Natal. Ekuseni kuyabanda, futhi utshani bumhlophe ngenxa yesithwathwa. UMlindeli uvuka ngehora lesihlanu ekuseni, ngesikhathi ubumnyama bugcwele yonke indawo. Uphuma endlini, aqhaqhazele ngenxa yamakhaza. Izandla zakhe ziyaqhaqhazela, nezinyawo zakhe ziyaqhaqhazela.

Ngaphambi kokuthi agijime, uMlindeli ufudumeza umzimba wakhe. Uqala ngokuhamba kancane, bese egxuma kancane. Uthi: "Uma ngingawufudumezi umzimba, ngizozilimaza." Ngemuva kwemizuzu eyishumi umzimba wakhe ufudumele, bese eqala ukugijima.

Ugijima emgwaqweni oya ezintabeni. Isithwathwa sisemgwaqweni, ngakho uyaxwaya ukuthi angawi. Ngemuva kwehora elilodwa uyajuluka, nakuba kusabanda. Ijuluka liphuma ebusweni bakhe nasemhlane. Uyajuluka kakhulu, kodwa akemi. Uzitshela ukuthi: "Qinisela, Mlindeli. Qinisela!"

Ngolunye usuku uMlindeli ufika ekhaya enobuhlungu ozwaneni. Ukhumula izicathulo zakhe, abheke izinzwane zakhe. Uzwane lwakhe olukhulu lubomvu, futhi uzipho lwalo lumnyama. Umfazi wakhe uthi: "Izicathulo zakho zincane kakhulu. Izinzipho zakho zishaya isicathulo uma ugijima." Ngakusasa uMlindeli uthenga izicathulo ezinkulu kancane, futhi asike izinzipho zakhe. Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili uzwane lwakhe luphilile futhi.

Ezinye izinsuku uMlindeli ugijima ekuhlweni, ngemuva komsebenzi. Ngokuhlwa amayezi amnyama ayagcwala esibhakabhakeni, futhi umoya uyabanda. Ngolunye usuku ekuhlweni kufika amayezi amakhulu, bese imvula iqala ukuna. UMlindeli uyaqhaqhazela, kodwa uyaqinisela. Uthi: "Amayezi namakhaza ngeke angivimbe."

Ekugcineni kufika usuku lomjaho. Ekuseni kunesithwathwa futhi, kodwa uMlindeli akaqhaqhazeli, ngoba ufudumeze umzimba wakhe kahle. Ugijima amahora ayishumi. Uyajuluka, izinyawo zakhe zibuhlungu, kodwa uyaqinisela. Ufika eThekwini ekuhlweni. Umfazi wakhe uyamlinda, futhi uyajabula. UMlindeli uthi: "Ngaqinisela ebusika bonke. Namuhla ngibona ukuthi kwakufanele."

Imibuzo:
UMlindeli ufuna ukugijima nini umjaho omude?
Ufuna ukuwugijima ngoNtulikazi.
Kungani utshani bumhlophe ekuseni?
Bumhlophe ngenxa yesithwathwa.
Wenzani uMlindeli ngaphambi kokuthi agijime?
Ufudumeza umzimba wakhe, ngoba uma engawufudumezi uzozilimaza.
Kwenzekani ozwaneni lwakhe?
Uzwane lwakhe lwalubomvu, futhi uzipho lwalo lwalumnyama, ngoba izicathulo zazincane.
Kwenzekani ngolunye usuku ekuhlweni?
Kwafika amayezi amakhulu, kwana imvula, kodwa uMlindeli waqinisela.

lessons.title: Igalofu neNgisi
lessons.summary: Nqubeko plays golf in Durban with his English colleague James: he keeps missing the hole and James teases him, they joke, look around the long grass for a lost ball while a hare runs out, find it under a spider web, and rest on chairs afterwards.
lessons.text:
UNqubeko uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu. Usebenza ehhovisi eThekwini, futhi ngoMgqibelo uthanda ukudlala igalofu. Igalofu ngumdlalo onzima. Umdlali ushaya ibhola elincane ngenduku, futhi kufanele alifake emgodini omncane okude kakhulu.

NgoMgqibelo othile uNqubeko udlala igalofu nomngane wakhe womsebenzi, uJames. UJames uyiNgisi. Wazalelwa eLondon, kodwa uhlala eThekwini iminyaka emibili. AmaNgisi amaningi ayayithanda igalofu, futhi uJames uyidlala kahle kakhulu.

UJames ushaya ibhola lakhe kuqala. Ibhola liya kude, lehle eduze komgodi. Bese kudlala uNqubeko. Ushaya ibhola lakhe ngamandla, kodwa uyageja. Ibhola lidlula umgodi, liye kude. UJames uyamgcona: "Nqubeko, ibhola lakho aliwuthandi umgodi!" UNqubeko akathukutheli. Naye uyancokola: "Ibhola lami liyawesaba umgodi, mngane wami."

Emgodini wesithathu uNqubeko uyageja futhi. UJames uyamgcona futhi, futhi bobabili bayahleka. Abangane abahle bayancokola, futhi abathukutheli uma omunye ebagcona.

Emgodini wesine uJames ushaya ibhola ngamandla amakhulu. Ibhola liyawa otshanini obude eduze kwehlathi elincane. Bobabili bayaqalaza. Baqalaza isikhathi eside, kodwa ibhola alibonakali. Bese kuphuma unogwaja otshanini, agijime ngejubane. UJames uthi: "Mhlawumbe unogwaja uthathe ibhola lami!" UNqubeko uyahleka: "Cha, onogwaja abadlali igalofu."

Bayaqhubeka beqalaza. Ekugcineni uNqubeko ubona ibhola phansi kwesihlahla. Ibhola limhlophe, kodwa phezu kwalo kunobulembu obukhulu. UJames uphakamisa amashiya akhe. Amashiya akhe aphezulu, ngoba akabuthandi ubulembu. UNqubeko uthatha induku, asule ubulembu ebholeni. UJames uthi: "Ngiyabonga, mngane wami. ELondon ubulembu abukhulu kanje!"

Ngemuva komdlalo abangane bahlala ezitulweni ngaphandle kwendlu yeqembu legalofu. UJames uhlala esitulweni esikhulu, uNqubeko esitulweni esincane. Baphuza itiye. UJames unqobile namuhla, kodwa uNqubeko uyancokola futhi: "NgoMgqibelo ozayo ngizonqoba. Uzogeja wena, futhi unogwaja uzothatha ibhola lakho."

Imibuzo:
UJames uvelaphi?
UJames uyiNgisi, wazalelwa eLondon.
Kwenzekani uma uNqubeko eshaya ibhola lakhe?
Uyageja, ibhola lidlula umgodi.
Wenzani uJames uma uNqubeko egeja?
Uyamgcona, kodwa bobabili bayahleka futhi bayancokola.
Benzani eduze kwehlathi?
Bayaqalaza befuna ibhola likaJames, futhi babona unogwaja ephuma otshanini.
Kungani uJames ephakamisa amashiya akhe?
Ngoba ibhola linobulembu obukhulu, futhi uJames akabuthandi ubulembu.

lessons.title: Ulwandle lukaMfumfu
lessons.summary: Ntombithini trains in the sea at Durban for an October race while her grandfather watches with his walking stick; a shark alarm and a strong current frighten her, her grandfather raises his stick to call for help, and on race day the roaring sea calms down.
lessons.text:
UNtombithini uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye. Uhlala eThekwini nomkhulu wakhe, uMzikayise. UNtombithini uthanda ukubhukuda olwandle, futhi ngoMfumfu uzobhukuda emjahweni omkhulu wolwandle. UMfumfu uyinyanga enhle eThekwini: amanzi aqala ukufudumala, futhi abantu abaningi bayeza ebhishi.

UMzikayise mdala kakhulu. Uhamba ngodondolo, ngoba imilenze yakhe ayinamandla. Nsuku zonke ekuseni uhamba nomzukulu wakhe aye ebhishi. Uhlala esihlabathini, udondolo lwakhe eduze kwakhe, abuke uNtombithini ebhukuda.

Ngolunye usuku ekuqaleni kukaMfumfu ulwandle luxolile. Amagagasi mancane, futhi amagwebu amhlophe ambalwa kuphela. UNtombithini ungena emanzini, abhukude kude nogu. Uyajabula, ngoba ulwandle luxolile.

Ngemuva kwesikhashana abasindisi bakhala kakhulu: "Ushaka! Ushaka! Phumani emanzini!" UNtombithini uyaqalaza. Kude ubona into emnyama emanzini. Uyesaba kakhulu. Ujikela ogwini, abhukude ngamandla akhe onke.

Kodwa manje amanzi agobhoza ngamandla, asuka ogwini aye olwandle. UNtombithini ubhukuda, kodwa amanzi agobhozayo amdonsela emuva. Uyakhathala. Inkathazo enkulu ingena enhliziyweni yakhe.

Esihlabathini uMzikayise uyasukuma. Uphakamisa udondolo lwakhe phezulu, akhale: "Uncedo! Uncedo! Umzukulu wami usemanzini!" Abasindisi babona udondolo lukaMzikayise, bagijimele emanzini. Bafika kuNtombithini, bamsize abuyele ogwini.

Esihlabathini uNtombithini ujikela kumkhulu wakhe. Uyaqhaqhazela. Uthi: "Mkhulu, ngiyabonga ngoncedo lwakho." UMzikayise uthi: "Ushaka wayengekho eduze kwakho, kodwa amanzi agobhozayo ayingozi enkulu. Ngakho ngakhala ngicela uncedo." Abasindisi bathi into emnyama yayiyisikebhe esincane, hhayi ushaka.

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili kufika usuku lomjaho. Ekuseni ulwandle aluxolile. Umoya unamandla, futhi ulwandle luyabhodla njengenkomo enkulu. UNtombithini uyalalela ulwandle lubhodla, futhi inkathazo iyabuya enhliziyweni yakhe. Amagwebu amaningi amhlophe agcwele amagagasi. Kodwa ngehora leshumi umoya uyaxola, nolwandle luyaxola. UNtombithini uyabhukuda, uqeda emjahweni endaweni yesibili. UMzikayise umbuka esihlabathini, aphakamise udondolo lwakhe, ngoba uyajabula kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
UNtombithini uzobhukuda nini emjahweni omkhulu?
Uzobhukuda ngoMfumfu.
Kungani uMzikayise ehamba ngodondolo?
Ngoba mdala, futhi imilenze yakhe ayinamandla.
Abasindisi bakhala bathini?
Bakhala bathi: "Ushaka! Phumani emanzini!"
Kungani uNtombithini ekhathala emanzini?
Ngoba amanzi agobhoza ngamandla, amdonsela emuva.
Into emnyama emanzini yayiyini?
Yayiyisikebhe esincane, hhayi ushaka.
Wenzani uNtombithini uma ebona into emnyama?
Ujikela ogwini, abhukude ngamandla akhe onke.

lessons.title: Umncintiswano wokugida
lessons.summary: Nondaba's school dance team in Eshowe practises for a September dance contest in Durban; a new Xhosa girl, Zenande, learns that all Nguni share their customs, hair is dressed with feathers, the team waits behind the curtain and wins a goat.
lessons.text:
UNondaba uneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha. Ufunda esikoleni samantombazane eShowe, futhi uthanda ukugida kakhulu. Ugida eqenjini lomdanso lesikole. Umqeqeshi weqembu nguMavundla, owesifazane omdala ogida kahle kakhulu.

NgoMandulo abantu abaningi bagubha amasiko abo namagugu abo. NgoMandulo walo nyaka kuzoba nesigigaba esikhulu eThekwini: umncintiswano wokugida wezikole zonke zaKwaZulu-Natal. Lesi sigigaba sikhulu kakhulu esikoleni sikaNondaba. Iqembu elizonqoba lizothola impongo enkulu, nemali yesikole.

Ngakho iqembu ligida nsuku zonke ngemuva kwesikole. Ukugida amahora amabili nsuku zonke kuyabadina amantombazane, kodwa ayaqhubeka. UMavundla uthi: "Uma kunidina, phumulani kancane, bese nigida futhi."

Ngolunye usuku kufika intombazane entsha eqenjini. Igama layo nguZenande. UZenande ungumXhosa, uvela eMthatha. Umndeni wakhe ufike eShowe ngenyanga edlule. UZenande unamahloni. Uthi: "Ngiyakwazi ukugida, kodwa angazi ukugida ngendlela yamaZulu."

UNondaba uthi: "Ungesabi. AmaZulu namaXhosa bonke bangabeNguni. Thina abeNguni sinamasiko afanayo, nezingoma zethu ziyafana." UNondaba ufundisa uZenande. Emasontweni amabili uZenande ugida kahle njengamanye amantombazane.

Usuku lwesigigaba luyafika. Ekuseni umama kaNondaba ucwala izinwele zamantombazane onke. Ucwala izinwele zikaNondaba kuqala, bese ecwala izinwele zikaZenande. Ezinweleni zabo bafaka izimpaphe ezimhlophe. UZenande ufaka uphaphe olude olubomvu, ngoba umama wakhe wamnika lona eMthatha.

Ehholo elikhulu eThekwini iqembu lilinda ngemuva kwekhethini elibomvu. Ngemuva kwekhethini kushisa, futhi ukulinda kuyabadina amantombazane. Kodwa ikhethini liyavuleka. Amantombazane ayangena, agide ngamandla. Izimpaphe zawo ziyagida nazo, futhi abantu bashaya ihlombe.

Ekugcineni amajaji athi iqembu lakwaShowe linqobile. UMavundla uthola impongo enkulu emhlophe. Impongo iyakhala, futhi amantombazane ayahleka. UZenande uthi kuNondaba: "Ngiyabonga, mngane wami. Namuhla ngiyintombazane yeqembu lenu ngempela."

Imibuzo:
Kuzoba nesigigaba esinjani eThekwini ngoMandulo?
Kuzoba nomncintiswano wokugida wezikole zonke zaKwaZulu-Natal.
Iqembu elizonqoba lizotholani?
Lizothola impongo enkulu, nemali yesikole.
UZenande ungubani?
UZenande ungumXhosa ovela eMthatha, intombazane entsha eqenjini.
UNondaba uthini kuZenande ngamaZulu namaXhosa?
Uthi bonke bangabeNguni, futhi banamasiko afanayo.
Kwenzekani ngemuva kwekhethini?
Kushisa, futhi ukulinda kuyabadina amantombazane.

lessons.title: Ukudla kwesibhakela
lessons.summary: Soweto boxer Mzwakhe must lose three thousand grams before a fight: his coach Khanyile weighs every meal in grams, allows one slice of cheese, rice and chopped cabbage, honey in tea instead of grapes that are dear in winter; he grows thin, makes the weight and wins.
lessons.text:
UMzwakhe uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Uhlala eSoweto, futhi ushaya isibhakela. Ngenyanga ezayo unomdlalo omkhulu nomunye umdlali wesibhakela omdala, futhi uma enqoba uzoba yiqhawe leSoweto. Kodwa kunenkinga eyodwa: uMzwakhe usinda kakhulu. Kufanele anciphise amagremu ayinkulungwane amathathu ngaphambi komdlalo.

Umqeqeshi wakhe, uKhanyile, uthi: "Mzwakhe, kusukela namuhla uzodla ngendlela entsha. Uzokala konke ukudla kwakho ngamagremu." Umnika iphepha elinohlu lokudla.

Ekuseni uMzwakhe udla amagremu angamashumi amahlanu esinkwa, neqanda elilodwa. Akathathi ushizi, ngoba ushizi unamafutha amaningi. Kodwa uthanda ushizi kakhulu. Ngakho uKhanyile uthi: "Ungadla ucwecwe olulodwa lukashizi, kodwa olulodwa kuphela." UMzwakhe usika ushizi ngommese, uthathe ucwecwe oluncane.

Emini udla amagremu ayikhulu elayisi, nenyama encane, nemifino eminingi. Uthanda iklabishi, ngoba iklabishi linempilo futhi aliduli. UMzwakhe uqoba iklabishi elikhulu ngommese, alifake ebhodweni. Ngosuku olulodwa udla iklabishi lonke, futhi akayidingi inyama eningi.

Ngemuva kokuqeqeshwa uMzwakhe ufuna into emnandi. UKhanyile uthi: "Ungadli izinto ezinoshukela. Phuza itiye noju oluncane, futhi udle amagilebhisi ambalwa." Kodwa ebusika amagilebhisi ayadula eSoweto. Isitolo esiseduze sithengisa amagilebhisi ngemali eningi kakhulu. UMzwakhe uthi: "Amagilebhisi ayadula kakhulu! Ngizophuza itiye noju kuphela."

Emasontweni amathathu uMzwakhe uyonda. Amabhulukwe akhe makhulu kakhulu manje. Umama wakhe uyakhathazeka: "Mntwana wami, uyonda kakhulu! Ungondi njengenduku." Kodwa uKhanyile uthi: "Ungakhathazeki. UMzwakhe akondanga kakhulu. Unamandla futhi uphilile."

Ngosuku olungaphambi komdlalo uMzwakhe uyakalwa. Unciphise amagremu ayinkulungwane amathathu! UKhanyile uyajabula. Ngakusasa uMzwakhe ulwa kahle, futhi uyanqoba. Ebusuku udla ilayisi eliningi nenyama, noshizi omningi.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMzwakhe kufanele adle ngendlela entsha?
Ngoba usinda kakhulu, kufanele anciphise amagremu ayinkulungwane amathathu.
Kungani engathathi ushizi omningi?
Ngoba ushizi unamafutha amaningi, ngakho uthatha ucwecwe olulodwa kuphela.
UMzwakhe wenzani ngeklabishi?
Uliqoba ngommese, alifake ebhodweni.
Kungani uMzwakhe engathengi amagilebhisi?
Ngoba ebusika amagilebhisi ayadula kakhulu, ngakho uphuza itiye noju.
Umama wakhe uthini?
Uthi uMzwakhe uyonda kakhulu, futhi akafuni ukuthi onde njengenduku.

lessons.title: IsiFulentshi sikaMnotho
lessons.summary: Durban sprinter Mnotho is picked for a February race in Paris: he applies for a permit, buys a French dictionary and struggles with French vowels, his girlfriend Nombulelo, who learns Chinese, teaches him adverbs, his coach makes him shorten his speech, and he says I love you on the phone before flying.
lessons.text:
UMnotho uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Uhlala eThekwini, futhi ugijima ngejubane elikhulu. Ugijima amamitha ayikhulu kangcono kunabo bonke abagijimi baseThekwini. Ngolunye usuku umqeqeshi wakhe uthi: "Mnotho, ukhethiwe! NgoNhlolanja uzogijima emjahweni omkhulu eParis, eFulansi."

UMnotho uyajabula kakhulu, kodwa unezinkinga ezimbili. Okokuqala, udinga imvumo yokungena eFulansi. Okwesibili, akasazi isiFulentshi. Uthi: "Angifuni ukuthula njalo eParis. Ngifuna ukukhuluma nabantu kancane."

Ngakho uMnotho uya ehhovisi lezimvumo, agcwalise amaphepha. Umsebenzi wehhovisi uthi: "Imvumo yakho izofika emasontweni amathathu." Bese uMnotho ethenga isichazamazwi sesiFulentshi nesiNgisi. Leso sichazamazwi sikhulu futhi sisinda, kodwa uMnotho usithatha nsuku zonke.

Ebusuku uMnotho ufunda amagama esichazamazwini. Kodwa isiFulentshi sinzima. Onkamisa besiFulentshi abafani nonkamisa besiZulu. IsiZulu sinonkamisa abahlanu kuphela, kodwa isiFulentshi sinonkamisa abaningi kakhulu. UMnotho uthi: "Onkamisa balolu limi bayangihlupha!"

UNombulelo, intombi yakhe, ufunda isiShayina, ngoba ufuna ukusebenza eBeijing ngolunye usuku. Uthi: "Mnotho, isiShayina sinzima kakhulu kunesiFulentshi. EsiShayineni igama elilodwa lingasho izinto eziningi." UNombulelo uyamsiza uMnotho. Uthi: "Funda izandiso ezimbalwa kuqala. Isandiso sichaza ukuthi into yenziwa kanjani: kahle, kancane, ngokushesha. Abagijimi badinga izandiso ezifana nokuthi 'ngokushesha'!" UMnotho uyahleka, afunde izandiso ezilula.

Ngaphambi kokuhamba, umqeqeshi uthi uMnotho kufanele akhulume emhlanganweni omkhulu eParis. UMnotho ubhala amazwi amaningi ngesiNgisi, kodwa umqeqeshi uthi: "Wafinyeze. Abantu bathanda umuntu okhuluma ngamafuphi." UMnotho uyawafinyeza amazwi akhe, abe imisho emihlanu kuphela. Ubhala imisho emifuphi, afake namagama ambalwa esiFulentshi.

NgoNhlolanja imvumo yakhe isifikile, futhi uMnotho uya eParis ngebhanoyi. Ngaphambi kokungena ebhanoyini ushayela uNombulelo ucingo. Uthi: "Ngiyakuthanda, Nombulelo. Ngiyabonga ngoncedo lwakho." UNombulelo uthi: "Nami ngiyakuthanda. Gijima ngokushesha, futhi ukhulume kahle!"

Imibuzo:
UMnotho uzogijima kuphi ngoNhlolanja?
Uzogijima emjahweni omkhulu eParis, eFulansi.
Yiziphi izinkinga ezimbili anazo?
Udinga imvumo yokungena eFulansi, futhi akasazi isiFulentshi.
Kungani isiFulentshi sinzima kuMnotho?
Ngoba onkamisa besiFulentshi abafani nonkamisa besiZulu.
UNombulelo uthini ngezandiso?
Uthi isandiso sichaza ukuthi into yenziwa kanjani, njengokuthi kahle noma ngokushesha.
Umqeqeshi uthini ngamazwi kaMnotho?
Uthi kufanele awafinyeze, ngoba abantu bathanda umuntu okhuluma ngamafuphi.

lessons.title: Udonga lukakhonkolo
lessons.summary: Thembalethu in Madadeni annoys his football coach Hlophe with excuses for coming late; an old concrete wall by the pitch collapses in the rain while the boys are inside, they pile up the rubble, Thembalethu knocks against a goalpost, and the coach loosens his boot and strokes his swollen ankle.
lessons.text:
UThembalethu uneminyaka eyishumi nesihlanu. Uhlala eMadadeni, futhi udlala ibhola eqenjini lesikole sakhe. Udlala kahle kakhulu, kodwa unenkinga eyodwa: uhlale efika emuva kwesikhathi, futhi njalo unezaba. NgoMsombuluko uthi ibhasi lifike emuva kwesikhathi. NgoLwesithathu uthi umama wakhe ugulile. NgoLwesihlanu uthi ihembe lakhe lebhola belisemanzini.

Umqeqeshi, uHlophe, ukhathele yizaba. UThembalethu uyamcunula kakhulu ngezaba. Uthi: "Thembalethu, ibhola alidlalwa ngezaba. Uma ufika emuva kwesikhathi futhi, ngeke udlale ngoMgqibelo." UThembalethu uyaxolisa, kodwa uHlophe usathukuthele. Ukulinda umfana ofika emuva kwesikhathi kuyamcunula kakhulu.

Eduze kwenkundla yesikole kunodonga oludala lukakhonkolo. Lolu donga lude futhi lubanzi, kodwa ukhonkolo walo mdala kakhulu. Ezinye izingxenye zalo ziyaphuka. UHlophe uthi kubafana: "Ningahlali eduze kodonga. Ngelinye ilanga luzobhidlika."

NgoLwesine kuna imvula enkulu emini. Abafana bayaqeqeshwa enkundleni, kodwa uHlophe ubathumela ngaphakathi. Ngemuva kwemizuzu embalwa bezwa umsindo omkhulu. Udonga lukakhonkolo luyabhidlika! Amatshe kakhonkolo anqwabelana phansi, aba yinqwaba enkulu. Ngenhlanhla bonke abafana babesendlini.

Ngakusasa abafana banqwabela amatshe kakhonkolo eceleni kwenkundla, ukuze bakwazi ukudlala futhi. UThembalethu ufika kuqala namuhla, ngaphandle kwezaba. Usebenza kanzima, anqwabele amatshe amaningi.

Ngemuva kwalokho abafana badlala ibhola. UThembalethu ugijima ngejubane, kodwa akaboni isigxobo segoli. Ungqubuza nesigxobo, awe phansi. Iqakala lakhe liyaqumba ngokushesha. Liqumba kakhulu, futhi libomvu.

UHlophe uyagijima, ahlale phansi eduze kwakhe. Uxegisa izintambo zesicathulo sakhe, ngoba iqakala liyaqumba ngaphakathi kwesicathulo. Bese uphulula unyawo lwakhe kancane. Uthi: "Ungesabi. Ngizokuphulula kancane, bese sifaka iqhwa." UThembalethu ukhumula ihembe lakhe. UHlophe ubeka iqhwa phakathi kwehembe, bese elibopha eqakaleni.

Ngemuva kwesonto iqakala alisaqumbile. UThembalethu ubuyela eqenjini, futhi ufika ngesikhathi nsuku zonke. Akasenzi izaba. UHlophe uyajabula. Uthi: "Udonga lubhidlikile, futhi wena awusenzi izaba!"

Imibuzo:
Iyiphi inkinga kaThembalethu?
Uhlale efika emuva kwesikhathi, futhi njalo unezaba.
Kungani uHlophe ethi abafana bangahlali eduze kodonga?
Ngoba ukhonkolo wodonga mdala, futhi luzobhidlika ngelinye ilanga.
Kwenzekani ngoLwesine emini?
Kwana imvula enkulu, futhi udonga lukakhonkolo lwabhidlika.
Kwenzekani lapho uThembalethu engqubuza nesigxobo?
Uwa phansi, futhi iqakala lakhe liyaqumba.
UHlophe wenzani ngesicathulo sakhe?
Uxegisa izintambo zesicathulo, bese ephulula unyawo lwakhe.

lessons.title: Umklomelo onamadayimane
lessons.summary: Old running champion Mzingisi in Johannesburg is robbed of his gold trophy with diamonds and beaten; a prostitute on the street helps him and describes the robber, the police spy Zweli sets a trap with a newspaper notice, finds the trophy in an iron box held under a car by a magnet, and the robbers go to jail.
lessons.text:
Eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu edlule uMzingisi wayengumdlali odumile wokugijima. Manje mdala, kodwa usagcina imiklomelo yakhe yonke endlini yakhe eGoli. Eminyakeni eminingi waqokelela imiklomelo eminingi kakhulu. Umklomelo wakhe omkhulu wenziwe ngegolide, futhi unamadayimane amancane amahlanu. Amadayimane awo akhanya kakhulu.

NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku uMzingisi uya ehholo eliseduze, ukuze adle nabangane bakhe abadala bokugijima. Uthatha umklomelo onamadayimane esikhwameni, ukuze awukhombise abangane bakhe. Ngemuva kokudla uhamba yedwa emgwaqweni. Bese kuphuma amadoda amabili ebumnyameni. Enye ithi: "Sinike isikhwama sakho!" Bamqhwaga isikhwama, futhi enye igqilaza uMzingisi ngezibhakela. UMzingisi uwa phansi, amadoda abaleke nesikhwama.

Eduze komgwaqo kukhona owesifazane. Ungumqwayizi, usebenza kulowo mgwaqo ebusuku. Lo mqwayizi ubona yonke into. Uyagijima, asize uMzingisi, bese eshayela amaphoyisa ucingo.

Amaphoyisa athumela inhloli yawo, uZweli. Inhloli ikhuluma nomqwayizi. Umqwayizi uthi: "Enye indoda yayigqoke isigqoko esibomvu. Yangena emotweni endala emhlophe." UZweli uthi: "Ngiyabonga. Uncedo lwakho lukhulu."

UZweli uyacupha. Ufaka amazwi ephepheni lezindaba: "Ngithenga amadayimane, ngikhokha kahle." Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili kufika indoda egqoke isigqoko esibomvu. Ifuna ukuthengisa amadayimane amahlanu. UZweli uthi: "Ngizobona amanye amadayimane ngomuso, ekhaya lakho." Indoda ithi lokho kulungile.

Ngakusasa uZweli namaphoyisa bafika endlini yendoda. Imoto emhlophe imi ngaphandle kwendlu. Kodwa umklomelo awukho endlini. Inhloli iqalaza, bese ihlola ngaphansi kwemoto. Lapho kukhona ibhokisi lensimbi elinamathele ngozibuthe. UZweli uthi: "Bheka! Le ndoda isebenzise uzibuthe onamandla. Ichopho likazibuthe linamathela ensimbini, ngakho ibhokisi aliwi." Ukhipha ibhokisi ngamandla echosheni likazibuthe. Ngaphakathi kukhona umklomelo kaMzingisi, namanye amadayimane.

Amaphoyisa ayawabamba amadoda amabili, awafake ejele. Ujele wejele uvala umnyango ngamandla. Ujele uthi: "Lapha ngeke nithole amadayimane."

UMzingisi uthola umklomelo wakhe futhi. Uthumela izimbali kumqwayizi nakuZweli, ngoba uncedo lwabo lwabuyisa umklomelo wakhe.

Imibuzo:
UMzingisi waqokelelani eminyakeni eminingi?
Waqokelela imiklomelo eminingi, nomklomelo wegolide onamadayimane.
Kwenzekani kuMzingisi emgwaqweni ebusuku?
Amadoda amabili amqhwaga isikhwama, futhi enye yamgqilaza ngezibhakela.
Umqwayizi wabonani?
Wabona indoda egqoke isigqoko esibomvu, ingena emotweni endala emhlophe.
UZweli wacupha kanjani?
Wafaka amazwi ephepheni lezindaba athi uthenga amadayimane.
Ibhokisi lensimbi lalikuphi?
Lalinamathele ngaphansi kwemoto ngozibuthe.

lessons.title: Izinduku zomshado
lessons.summary: Twins Mbuyiselo, the first-born, and Bhekithemba live with their grandfather Shange, a goat and cattle breeder in Msinga; to get strong for the stick game at a wedding they hoe a field, their grandmother brews beer in calabashes from the granary, sparks fly from their fire, and they chase a hyena away from the goats.
lessons.text:
UMbuyiselo noBhekithemba bayizinsizwa ezineminyaka eyishumi nesithupha. Bazalwa ngosuku olulodwa, ngehora elilodwa. UMbuyiselo wazalwa kuqala, ngakho ungunqangi. Bahlala nomkhulu wabo uShange eMsinga. UShange ungumfuyi omkhulu wezimbuzi nezinkomo. Bonke abantu baseMsinga bayamazi lo mfuyi, ngoba izimbuzi zakhe zinhle futhi zinamandla.

Ngenyanga ezayo kuzoba nomshado omkhulu emzini kaShange. Emshadweni kuzoba nomdlalo wezinduku wezinsizwa, futhi abantu bazobuka. UMbuyiselo noBhekithemba bafuna ukulwa ngezinduku emshadweni. Kodwa umkhulu wabo uthi: "Ningakhulumi ngezinduku kuqala. Thathani amageja, nilime isivande. Igeja lenza izingalo zibe namandla."

Ngakho nsuku zonke ekuseni izinsizwa ziyalima isivande esikhulu eduze komfula. Igeja likaMbuyiselo lisha, kodwa igeja likaBhekithemba lidala. Bayajuluka, kodwa bayaqinisela. Ngemuva kwamasonto amathathu bayaqeda ukulima isivande sonke, futhi izingalo zabo zinamandla.

Ugogo wabo uyaphisa utshwala bomshado. Uphisa utshwala obuningi ngamabhodwe amakhulu. Ngemuva kwalokho ubufaka emaguleni. Amagula akhe makhulu futhi madala, kodwa ugogo uthi: "Utshwala bumnandi kakhulu eguleni." Amabele okuphisa utshwala ugogo uwathatha enqolobaneni. Inqolobana yabo igcwele amabele nommbila.

Ebusuku izinsizwa ziphemba umlilo ngaphandle kwendlu. UBhekithemba uphemba umlilo ngotshani obomile nezinkuni ezincane. Izinhlansi zindiza phezulu esibhakabhakeni. UShange uthi: "Xwayani izinhlansi. Inhlansi eyodwa ingashisa inqolobana yethu."

Ngobunye ubusuku izinja zikhala kakhulu. Kukhona impisi eduze kwesibaya sezimbuzi! Impisi ifuna ukudla izimbuzi zomfuyi. UMbuyiselo noBhekithemba bathatha izinduku zabo, bagijimele esibayeni. Bashaya phansi ngezinduku, bakhale ngamandla. Impisi iyesaba, ibaleke iye ehlathini. UShange uyahleka: "Impisi iyazi ukuthi izingalo zenu zinamandla manje!"

Ngosuku lomshado izinsizwa zidlala umdlalo wezinduku nezinye izinsizwa. UMbuyiselo, unqangi, uyanqoba, futhi uBhekithemba naye udlala kahle kakhulu. Ugogo unika bonke abantu utshwala emaguleni. UShange unika izinsizwa zakhe imbuzi enhle.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMbuyiselo engunqangi?
Ngoba wazalwa kuqala, ngaphambi kukaBhekithemba.
UShange wenzani?
Ungumfuyi omkhulu wezimbuzi nezinkomo eMsinga.
UShange uthi izinsizwa zenzeni kuqala?
Uthi mazithathe amageja, zilime isivande, ukuze izingalo zibe namandla.
Ugogo ubufaka kuphi utshwala?
Ubufaka emaguleni amakhulu.
Izinsizwa zenzani uma impisi ifika?
Zithatha izinduku zazo, zigijimele esibayeni, zishaye phansi zikhale ngamandla.

lessons.title: Usuku lwezemidlalo
lessons.summary: Nomakhwezi and her brother Zanoxolo in Gingindlovu brush their teeth and take sugarcane to the school sports day: she wins a doll as a gift in the race for tiny children, the animal race and a sack race in which children hop like maggots and his underwear shows, and flies come for the sugarcane.
lessons.text:
UNomakhwezi uneminyaka eyisithupha, futhi ubhuti wakhe uZanoxolo uneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Bahlala eGingindlovu, edolobheni elincane eliphakathi kwamasimu amakhulu omoba. Namuhla kuwusuku lwezemidlalo esikoleni sabo, futhi bobabili bajabule kakhulu.

Ekuseni umama wabo uthi: "Xubhani amazinyo enu kuqala!" UNomakhwezi uyaxubha amazinyo akhe ngokushesha. UZanoxolo akafuni ukuxubha, kodwa umama uthi: "Uma ungaxubhi, ngeke uye ezemidlalo." Ngakho naye uyaxubha amazinyo akhe.

Umama ubafakela ukudla esikhwameni: isinkwa, amanzi, nomoba omningi. Abantwana baseGingindlovu bathanda ukuhlafuna umoba, ngoba umnandi futhi uyabapholisa. Umama usika umoba ube izingxenye ezincane.

Esikoleni kunabantwana abaningi nabazali babo. Umjaho wokuqala ngowezingane ezinci. UNomakhwezi mncane kakhulu, ngakho ugijima nezinye izingane ezinci. Umklomelo wengane enci ozonqoba ngudoli omuhle onezingubo eziluhlaza. UNomakhwezi ufuna udoli kakhulu. Ugijima ngamandla akhe onke, futhi uyanqoba! Umfundisi umnika udoli, uthi: "Lesi sipho ngesakho, Nomakhwezi." UNomakhwezi ubamba udoli wakhe ngothando, athi: "Lesi sipho sihle kakhulu!"

Bese kufika umjaho wezilwane. Abantwana bagqoka izingubo zezilwane: abanye bangamabhubesi, abanye bayizinkawu, abanye bangamahhashi. UZanoxolo ugqoke njengengwe. Umfundisi uthi: "Lezi zilwane zonke mazigijime!" Bonke bayagijima, futhi abazali bayahleka. Omunye ubaba uthi: "Lezi zilwane zigijima ngejubane elikhulu!" Ingwe kaZanoxolo iqeda endaweni yesibili. Umfundisi uthi: "Lesi silwane siyashesha! Lesi silwane sizothola umklomelo ngonyaka ozayo."

Umjaho wokugcina ngowezikhwama. Abantwana bangena ezikhwameni ezinkulu, bese begxuma. Bagxuma njengezibungu, futhi abazali bathi: "Bhekani izibungu ezinkulu!" UZanoxolo ugxuma ngamandla, kodwa ibhulukwe lakhe liyadabuka. Bonke bayasibona isikhindi sakhe esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka! Abantwana bayahleka. UZanoxolo unamahloni kancane, kodwa naye uyahleka. Uthi: "Isikhindi sami siyagijima nami!"

Emini bonke bahlala otshanini, badle umoba. Kodwa izimpukane ziyeza, ngoba umoba umnandi. Izimpukane zindiza eduze kwabo. Impukane eyodwa ihlala ekhaleni likaZanoxolo! Abantwana bayahleka futhi.

Ebusuku uNomakhwezi ulala nodoli wakhe. Ngaphambi kokulala bobabili bayaxubha amazinyo abo, ngaphandle kokuthi umama abatshele.

Imibuzo:
Umama uthi abantwana kufanele benzeni ekuseni?
Uthi kufanele baxubhe amazinyo abo kuqala.
UNomakhwezi uthola siphi isipho?
Uthola udoli omuhle, ngoba unqoba umjaho wezingane ezinci.
Kwenzekani emjahweni wezilwane?
UZanoxolo ugqoke njengengwe, futhi ingwe yakhe iqeda endaweni yesibili.
Kwenzekani kuZanoxolo emjahweni wezikhwama?
Ibhulukwe lakhe liyadabuka, futhi bonke babona isikhindi sakhe.
Kungani izimpukane ziyeza?
Ziyeza ngoba umoba umnandi.
